xmldoc.short_description: Bring every signal to one common rate in a single aligned matrix.

param_input_item.param_description: a file path or a struct from edf.read.
the interpolation: 'linear' (default) or 'nearest' (a zero-order hold, for a step-like or coded channel).

param_output_item.param_description: a struct with data (a matrix, one column per signal), t (the time vector in seconds), rate, labels and units.

description.p: A single common rate is what an analysis that reads every channel on one timeline needs; edf.read keeps each signal at its own native rate instead. The target time is clamped to each signal's own span so no value is extrapolated past its last sample.
